dialogues.speaker: Qingce Village Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Qingce Village Bulletin Board. You can find local news and notes from villagers posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "My son Zhang is a sturdy young man with a gentle personality, adept both in company and in the kitchen. He has a home in Liyue Harbor where he runs an honest family business making weapons, some of the finest you will see."

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "He's also humorous, warm-hearted, and — most importantly — handsome! If you're looking for a happy marriage, don't miss out! Come to Hanfeng's Ironmongers at Chihu Rock in Liyue Harbor to discuss now!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "I am already an old man and would love to have a grandchild. Please help..."
